slides.headline: Struck down by a light only he could see.
slides.sub: Caravaggio, The Conversion of Saint Paul, 1600-01

slides.headline: Saul rides to arrest Christians. A blinding *light* strikes him down.
He lies in the dust, eyes closed. He cannot *see*.
His arms reach up, as if to *embrace* the light.
His sword lies useless on the *ground*.
The huge horse lifts a hoof, careful not to *trample* him.
An old groom holds the horse. He sees *nothing*.
The horse bows its head, strangely *calm*.
His soldier's *helmet* lies beside him in the dust.
Caravaggio's first version was *replaced*. This one still hangs in Rome.
No angel, no sky. Only light, falling from *above*.
One second changed his whole life. Could *yours* change like that?
